fastF5Reload.concept: Granblue Fantasy animations execute client-side via CreateJS while the server state is computed immediately upon HTTP response. Reloading (F5) cancels client animations, allowing instant transition to the next turn once the server lockout timer expires.
pipeline: 2. Await HTTP 200 response with animation scenario payload.
4. Trigger CDP Page.reload or router navigate.
6. Calculate remaining lockout: Math.max(0, LockoutDuration - (Now - T_sent)).
7. Sleep for remaining lockout duration before dispatching next turn skills or attack.
